changes.to: Issue #1 (2026-11-24): figures from AVIC FACRI's own release (source line 航空工业自控所, published via 澎湃号, 2026-10-25) — walks a 10 degree slope, walks carrying 20 kg, jumps 30 cm, max about 3 km/h (= 0.83 m/s, converted), handles objects up to 15 kg (payload). Development self-funded since 2024; first shown at the 2026 World Robot Conference. No maker product page exists, so official_url is null. Height (about 1.8 m) and weight (80 kg) appear only in Global Times reporting attributed to AVIC staff, not in a maker document, so height_mm and weight_kg stay empty. No DoF, battery or runtime figure published.

Aviation-focused special-purpose humanoid from AVIC's flight-control institute with an electro-hydraulic hybrid drive, shown at WRC 2026 for aircraft manufacturing, ground support and loading work; prototype.
